Configure a 2D transient incompressible laminar flow-past-cylinder case using pimpleFoam.
The mesh is one cell thick in the z-direction, representing a true two-dimensional geometry.
In constant/polyMesh/boundary, set the frontAndBack patch type to empty.
In 0/U, set the frontAndBack boundary condition to type empty with no value entry specified.
These two entries must both be empty; do not use symmetryPlane or wall for frontAndBack in either file.
In 0/p, set the frontAndBack boundary condition to type empty.
All other patches (inlet, outlet, cylinderWall) retain their existing configurations appropriate for a flow-past-cylinder case.
For inlet, use fixedValue uniform for U and inletOutlet or fixedValue for p as already configured.
For outlet, use inletOutlet for U and fixedValue for p as already configured.
For cylinderWall, use no-slip wall (fixedValue uniform (0 0 0)) for U and zeroGradient for p as already configured.
In constant/transportProperties, set simulationType laminar and define a single nu scalar value appropriate for the target Reynolds number.
In system/fvSolution, use the PIMPLE algorithm (pimpleFoam defaults with outer corrector loops).
In system/fvSchemes, use transient discretization schemes (e.g., Euler for ddt, Gauss linear for div, grad, laplacian terms).
In system/controlDict, set transient solver time-stepping with a startAt, endTime, and deltaT consistent with the target Reynolds number and domain size.
Verify that no turbulence model files (e.g., constant/RASProperties or constant/turbulenceProperties with RASModel) are active; the case must run in laminar mode only.
Ensure the polyMesh boundary file does not list any frontAndBack patch with type symmetryPlane or type wall; the only acceptable type for frontAndBack is empty.
